Travel meal expenses Policy
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on travel meal expenses at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to EUR 60 per day, with receipts.
Conditions
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days after the trip.
Validity
Version 3.0, effective 2025-01-01. Supersedes version 1.2 (2022). Approved by the Management Committee.
